cli.conversation.noDelegator: This delegation didn't record the conversation that started it; use --session
cli.conversation.notUpstream: This tmux is neither a branch line nor a delegate; use --session
cli.credentials.hashed: The password is stored only as a scrypt hash; the plain text isn't kept in the file.
cli.credentials.restart: Restart the backend (for example {command}) to use the new login.
cli.credentials.restartGeneric: Restart the backend to use the new login.
cli.credentials.title: Set Hestia's login user name and password
cli.credentials.usernameEmpty: The user name can't be empty
cli.delegate.blocked: The user was told (delegation {id} needs attention). Carry on once they answer.
cli.delegate.delivered: Delivered delegation {id}; waiting for the user's review.
cli.delegate.deliveredForReview: Delivered delegation {id}; the delegating LLM reviews it first, then the user; feedback on a send-back arrives here.
cli.delegate.passed: Reviewed delegation {id}; the user reviews it in the app.
cli.delegate.proposed: Delegation proposed; waiting for the user to approve it in the app (to {profile}). The result comes back to this conversation by itself; status: hestia delegate status {id}
cli.delegate.roundsUsed: No send-backs left; delegation {id} went to the user for review.
cli.delegate.sentBack: Sent delegation {id} back (round {round}). The feedback goes in once the delegate is idle; its next delivery comes back to this conversation.
cli.delegate.started: Delegated to {profile}. The result comes back to this conversation by itself once delivered; status: hestia delegate status {id}
cli.delegate.stopped: Stopped delegation {id} ({state}). The delegate's tmux and working folder are kept.
cli.open.manyProjects: This folder belongs to more than one project:
cli.open.newProject: This folder isn't in any project yet. New project name (Enter for "{folder}"):
cli.pair.badUrl:
The backend address is wrong (from {source}): {url}
It must be an https:// address (http:// only for this machine's 127.0.0.1 or localhost), without a user name, password, ? or #.
cli.pair.expired: The pairing code expired without being used.
cli.pair.expiredAgain: Run hestia pair again to pair.
cli.pair.noUrl: This backend's address is unknown. Install with install.sh --tailscale, or pass --url with the Tailscale https://….ts.net address
cli.pair.openInApp: Or open it in the installed Hestia app:
cli.pair.openInBrowser: Or open it in the phone's browser:
cli.pair.reach: The phone must be able to reach {url}.
cli.pair.reachTailscale: The phone needs the Tailscale app, logged in to the same account as this host.
cli.pair.revokeAsk: Not you? Type r to revoke this login, or press Enter to finish:
cli.pair.revokeMissing: That login wasn't found; it may have logged out already.
cli.pair.revokedDetail: : that device has to log in again.
cli.pair.scan: In the Hestia app, tap "Scan QR code" under "Add host" (or scan with the phone's camera) to add this host and log in:
cli.pair.secret: • It is as good as a login to this host; don't photograph it or send it to anyone.
cli.pair.ssh: • When adding the host over SSH, tap "Log in with QR code" once connected.
cli.pair.validFor: • This pairing code works for {minutes} minutes, once; when it expires, run hestia pair again.
cli.pair.waiting: Waiting for a phone to scan… {left} left (Ctrl-C to quit)
